load_scanqa: load ScanQA dataset from a JSON file and return scanqa data, scannet scenes, and scene name to list ID mapping
get_scanqa_meta: get ScanQA dataset metadata including thing classes and dataset ID to contiguous ID mapping from a name map
register_scanqa: register ScanQA train, val, and test datasets with Detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog given a root directory
test_load_scanqa: test the load_scanqa function with a ScanQA JSON file path
review_register_scanqa: review the register_scanqa function and its Detectron2 DatasetCatalog registration logic
